title: 📌 Trade Finder: Must-Includes
notes: 📌 Trade Finder has a new "Must include" box. Name one or two of your players or picks, one or two of theirs, or both, and every deal it suggests will have them in it.
🔎 Want a certain player but not sure who has him? Leave the team on "Any team" and pick him under "From them". The Finder picks the team for you.
🏷️ Tab titles at the top (Standings, Research, Trade Desk) no longer get cut off on phones.
⚡ Interest Alerts no longer list your own team as interested in your own player.
📊 Charts now load from the app itself, so they still work with a weak signal.
